title: erigeron gypsoverus
intro: Erigeron gypsoverus, commonly known as the Mountain Fleabane or Alpine Fleabane, is a perennial plant species native to the high-altitude regions of the Andes mountain range. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron gypsoverus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron gypsoverus have been reported to include wound healing, pain relief, and immune system modulation.
